items.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: Oh, it was Bob McIntyre on drums and Bob Ice on bass and Frank Tallahoussi on piano and myself on banjo.

ctx.x: That's a nice way to record. What sort of style were you aiming at with the last straws when you first started?

Well, when we first started, we started Riverboat because we didn't have anything with a piano and bass and drums and bandroom. What was that? Oh, it was Bob McIntyre on drums and Bob Ice on bass and Frank Tallahoussi on piano and myself on banjo.
And what kind of bass was that? What was that?
